title: MEIKO — The Scales Of Justice〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: What lies behind. What lies ahead.

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Someone's just arrived.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Mizuki? Or...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, MEIKO, there you are!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ena? Luka...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm so glad that I found you!
And thanks for your help, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now that my work is done, I think I'll take a break here. Don't mind me, you two.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, thanks.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (She's sticking around to listen to us talk...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, Ena, why were you looking for me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: About that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I talked to Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh... And?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I realized what you meant by, “Sometimes, talking can make things worse,” which really helped me in the end.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Whenever something's bothering me, I usually complain about it openly or ask someone else for help because it makes me feel better...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I realize now that not everyone is like that. Thank you so much for telling me that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm glad it helped.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You must've already been aware of how Mizuki felt about talking, MEIKO, and how it probably wouldn't have helped.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I haven't actually talked to Mizuki about this, so I don't actually know for certain...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's fine.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because of what you said, MEIKO, I've decided to be patient and wait until Mizuki's ready to talk.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But this started to make me wonder about something else...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Something else?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. When I said that I'd wait, I really meant it. Even if it takes my whole life...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So I'm wondering if my declaration is going to make it hard for you or anyone else to talk to Mizuki about this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Ah, I see...
I don't think you need to worry about that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You are you, I am me...
We'll each take our own approaches.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And I've said this before.
I'm here to just observe, not intervene.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I get that but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree with MEIKO.
You don't need to mind us so much when it comes to this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I believe we're simply supposed to act as guides in your time of need.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Guides...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Although, some of us seem to enjoy sending you down more treacherous routes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that's very scary.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I believe you really should just do things the way you want.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And if you believe that waiting is the answer, then you'll just have to wait.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Right. I'll do that!
Thanks, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You don't need to thank me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. I want to thank you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If we're done, I'll be going now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO, wait.
Can I ask you one last thing?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What is it...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If something happens in the future, can I come talk to you about it?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Who was it that said she should do things the way she wants?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't mind listening...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That's plenty!
Thanks, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Bye...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And I really appreciate you sticking around like this, Luka. I was able to talk about what I needed to thanks to you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Feel free to ask me again.
I'll always be glad to help.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Especially if you're going to speak with MEIKO. Please let me know whenever you do.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sure, I promise. See you later!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Ugh... I heard all of that, Luka...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (No, that must've been deliberate.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Regardless, I plan on seeing this thing all the way through to watch where they end up...)
